Initial release of gws-calendar.

- Adds comprehensive Google Calendar management including calendars, events, ACLs, settings, and more.
- Supports helpful commands like creating events (+insert) and viewing agendas (+agenda).
- Integrates with the gws CLI; requires the gws binary.
- Includes helper documentation for browsing resources and method schemas.
